contexts.text: They attempted... to burden the conscience.
Let the service be made heavier upon the men () = that the assault is to be increased.
He made heavy his heart () = obstinacy... AC 7615.
To make heavy the heart = obstinacy from falsity; to harden the heart = obstinacy from evil.
How it is to be understood that it is said of Jehovah, that He made heavy the heart of Pharaoh. Explained.
